Getting through / ongoing

Daily run 2026-11-16, window Nov 12 - Nov 15 (2026-11-12 00:00 -> 2026-11-16 00:00 UTC) vs Nov 5 - Nov 11, 1% SYSTEM sample. STEP 1: 4 public-key slices (0-3 / 4-7 / 8-B / C-F), HAVING keys_spiking>=1 AND excess>=3k/day per slice (limit 60/80; slices 4-7 and 8-B complete, 0-3 and C-F hit the limit at ~110k and ~4k/day), merged by hand; a targeted re-run of slice 0-3 for 48 shortlisted flags filled the truncated tail (block sampling differs per run, so per-key counts move by ~10-20%). Excluded in SQL: key-level names (^x-[hec]-, incl. the 57 CHNGE-6738 key-level '-h-g-' TTs created Nov 10, zero baseline), g--e-*, audit-temp/ps-temp, events-count, bba-/is-signature, single-cookie, country+timezone family, dict-7/15/31, wired, fp-touch-*, g-atm*, ja4-dict-1, g-sdv-*, and the 6 CHNGE-6738 parents (created Nov 6, held until 2026-11-17). g-biometric-mouse-exact-replay-above-2-events-4plus and the appleos TT are back in (baselines clean): neither reaches 3 keys (above-2: gtop100 only ~8k/day; appleos TT: Uber Account Mgmt + Uber SMS). DI DICTIONARY REVERT: PARTIAL, LANDED IN THE WINDOW. m.davies re-defined dict-neg1 ST (THR-412, 2026-11-12 22:09:59 UTC), dict-neg1 LT (THR-413, 22:19:19), dict-1 1x (THR-408, 22:37:36), dict-1 5x (THR-409, 22:43:27), dict-1 10x (THR-410, 22:50:34) and dict-1 LT (THR-411, 22:54:18): the == -99 condition is gone, but the definitions also changed (di_short_term_threshold_ratio > 1.999 / 3.999 / 9.999, BofA Workforce ATM E8A64FAC excluded, OR-wrapped string variants dropped). dict-3 (1x THR-405, 4x THR-406, LT THR-407) still carries di_dictionary_num_matched == -99 (last commit 2026-10-27 03:05-03:10 UTC): NOT reverted, so the hold on didict3_dishort300 (BLUE-7297) stays. Treated as a definition change: dict-1 1x (6 keys ~74k/day: gtop100, Wells Fargo Login, DoorDash, Chime Login, Roblox Game Join, Roblox Signup), dict-1 5x (6 keys), dict-1 10x (2) and dict-neg1 ST (1) dropped, and so is their dependent g-device-parameter-spoofing (it #INCLUDEs dict-1 5x/10x and dict-neg1 ST/LT; 5 keys ~43k/day: theLott Login, Coinbase SMS, TIAA, 07D6B751, 63E4117F). Hold dict-1/neg1 and g-device-parameter-spoofing out of step 1 until 2026-11-24 (11 days after 22:54 UTC Nov 12); compare dp-spoof combo tracking only against days before Oct 27.
